_note: Behavior profiles. A species references one archetype via its `archetype` field; the AI reads these flags instead of the per-species `role` enum. New species = new species row + an archetype reference here, with no AI/gameplay code change. behaviorClass: prey|predator. baseState: initial/background state. packTactics: coordinated lead/flank/harry. apexThreat: counts as the apex pressure source. The extra flags (stalkPreferred, fightsWhenCornered, ...) are forward declarations for states added in migration steps 4-5; the current AI reads only behaviorClass, baseState, packTactics, apexThreat.
